info.title: ChipRadar B2B Hardware Pricing API
info.description:
REST API for real-time multi-vendor single-board computer (SBC), mini-PC,
and AI-accelerator pricing data. Endpoints are mounted under `/api/v1`
(board-centric) and `/api/v2` (product-centric); `/api/v3` is proxied to
the same `/api/v2` handlers.

**Authentication:** All B2B data endpoints require a Bearer API key:
`Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Get a free key instantly at
https://chipradar.io/api/keys.

**Rate limiting — 4-tier structure** (owner directive #3, 2026-11-11):

| Tier (slug) | Price | Monthly cap | Per-minute cap | Key features |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sandbox (free) | $0/mo | 100 | 5 | current deals + basic specs |
| Indie/Builder (indie) | $12/mo | 5,000 | 30 | LLM benchmarks, 90-day history, MCP access |
| Pro/Growth (pro) | $49/mo | 50,000 | 120 | full history, restock webhooks, metered overages |
| Enterprise/Supply Chain (enterprise) | $199/mo | 250,000+ | 600 | bulk exports, priority webhooks, custom SKU tracking |

Every B2B response includes rate-limit headers:
`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`,
`X-RateLimit-Limit-Minute`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-Minute`,
`X-RateLimit-Window`, `X-RateLimit-Tier`.

**MCP distribution:** The official MCP server lives at
https://github.com/RevenueClaw/chipradar/tree/main/mcp-chipradar and runs
in public demo mode without an API key.

**Amazon compliance:** `current_price` for Amazon-sourced products is
intentionally stored as `0` by design; live market prices come from
independent vendors tracked in `vendor_comparison`.

get.description:
Returns all active `price_tracked_products` joined with `board_specs`,
enriched with the cheapest in-stock vendor price from `vendor_comparison`.

Returns vendor price history for a single board from the `price_history`
table. Free tier is limited to 7 days.

Boards priced below MSRP, sorted by descending deal score. Free tier
returns at most 5 deals.

Public restock signals aggregated from the `restock_alerts` table.
Returns one row per product ASIN with alert count, last alert timestamp,
and current availability from `price_tracked_products`.
Cited LLM-on-board benchmark rows. Requires Indie/Builder tier or above ($12/mo).

example.citation: Every row links to its published source via source_url; figures are vendor/community-published, not ChipRadar lab measurements.

403.description: Tier does not include LLM benchmarks (Indie/Builder required).

example.error: LLM benchmark data requires the Indie/Builder tier or above.

get.description:
Rolling 24h health and budget status for all active inference providers.
Available to every tier; returns `providers: []` and `status: no-data-yet`
when the inference tables are empty.

get.summary: Per-provider routes for one inference model
get.description: Returns provider routes, prices, and 7-day probe metrics for a single model. Requires Indie/Builder tier or above.

get.summary: Recommend the best provider for a model
get.description: Ranks routes by cost, latency, or a balanced blend. Requires Indie/Builder tier or above.

Compares 30-day cloud inference spend against the cheapest in-stock board (from `vendor_comparison`, non-Amazon, ≤7 days fresh) that can run the model class on-device. Requires Indie/Builder tier or above.
